name: application-heart-rate-zone-bar
title: Heart Rate Zone Bar
description: Colored heart-rate zone distribution bar sized by real time-in-zone minutes, with a current-zone bpm marker positioned at the midpoint of the active segment — distinct from segment-breakdown-bar, which has no time-series marker or fitness-zone semantics.
useWhen: Summarizing how a workout's time was distributed across heart-rate zones.
You want a live bpm marker showing which zone the athlete is currently in.
Segment widths should be computed from real minute values per zone.
avoidWhen: You need a generic categorical proportion bar with no fitness semantics — use segment-breakdown-bar instead.
You need a live-updating countdown or rest timer — use countdown-ring-timer instead.
There's no current-zone concept to mark — a plain stacked bar is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The bar and marker scale fluidly with container width; the zone legend wraps onto multiple lines at narrow widths.
accessibility: Each zone segment carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the zone name and exact minutes, since width alone isn't announced by screen readers.
The current zone is indicated by both the bpm marker position and bold text in the legend, not color alone.
Zone colors progress from cool to warm (blue to red) to reinforce increasing intensity independent of hue perception.

variants.title: Heart rate zone bar
variants.description: A 37-minute session across five zones with a bpm marker centered in the currently-active Zone 3 segment, on a light surface.
accessibility: Segment widths and the marker position are both derived from the same real per-zone minute values.

variants.title: Heart rate zone bar (Dark)
variants.description: The same five-zone session, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Zone colors are shifted to lighter shades to meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
